description: Libya: The Area of Light Loss Caused by Floods is a hazard data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by International Research Center of Big Data for Sustainable Development Goals (CBAS). This dataset is showing the Gap Light Index (GLI) difference in Albayda and Derna. Coverage: Libya. The portal files it under the publisher International Research Center of Big Data for Sustainable Development Goals (CBAS). Its tags are libya-floods. It offers 1 resource(s) in GEODATABASE. The portal shows 2025-04-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
